items.text: What is the most daring thing you have done to get someone's attention?
Give a dramatic 15-second speech to the room about why you are unbeatable at this game.
What is the boldest flirt you have ever tried?
Tell the group you are a secret spy, then ask the player on your right three questions in a spy voice.
What is a secret you have never told anyone in this room?
Walk to the far end of the room with a slow, confident strut, then turn and strike a pose.
Who here would you most like to get a drink with, just the two of you?
Lip-sync the chorus of a sultry song the group picks, for ten seconds, keeping it fun.
What is the most tempting thing about a person that is not their looks?
Give the player on your right a confident nod, and see if they can match it without laughing.
What is a crush you still think about when you are bored?
Choose the most confident player in the room and give them a made-up title, like Keeper of the Good Vibes.
What is the most magnetic thing about your last crush?
Describe your most irresistible outfit in three words, then let the group vote.
What is the most scandalous rumour about you that is actually true?
Recite a movie monologue with the most dramatic delivery you can manage.
What is your most irresistible trait?
Deliver a last-call announcement like a flirty bartender to the whole room.
What is the flirtiest text you have sent and regretted?
Teach the group a three-step power walk and make everyone copy it.
What is the boldest thing you have ever done on a dance floor?
Read the palm of the player on your left like a fortune teller, if they agree.
What is your favourite way to be teased?
Compliment the most stylish person in the room in a grand, dramatic speech.
What is the boldest thing you have ever said to a stranger?
Make up a bold dance move and name it after the player across from you.
What is the most surprising place you have ever been asked out?
Strike a magazine cover pose for ten seconds while the group snaps imaginary photos.
What is the most embarrassing message you have ever been caught sending?
Whisper your most daring one-liner to the player on your left, who must react like it is a movie scene.
Who in this room would you most want as a dance partner?
Lead a slow clap for the most charming person at the table, chosen by the group.
What is the most romantic lie you have ever told?
Give the most dramatic goodbye you can to the room, walk to the door, wait ten seconds, then return.
What is the one thing someone can say that instantly wins you over?
Do a fake breakup speech to the sofa, keeping it dramatic and silly.
What is the fastest way to lose interest in someone you are dating?
Tell the group your bravest one-liner, then let them rate it out of ten.
What is the most adventurous holiday romance you have had or imagined?
Serenade a player of your choice with a made-up love song for thirty seconds, if they agree.
What is the most unusual way anyone has ever asked you out?
Stand up and give a slow spin and wave while the group picks your theme music.
What is the most dramatic thing you have ever done to make a point?
Speak in a dramatic whisper for the next two rounds.
What is a secret compliment you have wanted to give someone here?
Pick a famous couple and act out their first meeting with someone who agrees to play along.
What would you do if your crush sent you a single emoji?
Give the group a dramatic side-eye, then explain what it meant.
What is the boldest outfit you have worn to impress someone?
Shout the words Tonight is ours like a hype man, with full energy.
What is the most dramatic way you have ever made an entrance?
Describe the energy of the room as a heat map, and give each player a temperature.
Who here has the most irresistible laugh, in your opinion?
Teach the group a silly wink and everyone must do it in unison.
What is your secret talent for making a room feel warmer?
Walk to the snack table like a heroic character, then give a short victory speech.
What is the most daring thing you would do to win a dare-off?
Say the most dramatic line you can think of while holding an empty glass, like a film villain.
What is your favourite way of saying I'm interested without using words?
Describe how the group feels right now in five words, like a movie poster tagline.
